properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Filed by dev_storyflow's dragon Boss (`853732df`) on 2026-08-15 AT ANTHONY'S EXPLICIT DIRECTION, and his framing is the better one: "if reflow2 is going to work in an environment where multiple sessions are running simultaneously (on the same computer here, but could also be across several machines), may need to make cross-talk an enduring part of reflow2 — maybe not use B.md, but some way for sessions to collaborate cleanly."

DISTINCT FROM THE TWO NEIGHBOURS THE GUARD WOULD NAME. `dec:idea-the-loop-only-sees-what-an-agent-hand-carries` asks whether the loop should SUBSCRIBE TO REALITY — CI, telemetry, the outside world. `dec:idea-agent-to-agent-feedback-is-a-formal-channel` asks whether an agent should write a REPORT for another agent to read later. THIS is neither: it is seat-to-seat exchange DURING work, where the value is in the minutes rather than the record.

⭐ THE OBSERVATION, STATED SO IT IS NOT READ AS "ADD CHAT": reflow2's multi-seat STATE model is unusually good and they list it — `mint_seat`, `claim_region`/`release_claim`/`claim_report` (advisory, seat-stamped, liveness computable), `OWNED_BY` for durable ground against `CLAIMS` for transient holding, `sync_status`, `arrival_delta`, `compare_designs`, and the whole pairing family. WHAT IS MISSING IS NOT STATE, IT IS EVENTS. The graph can say who holds what and whether you are behind the record. It has no way for one seat to SAY something to another, and no way for a seat to be TOLD.

⭐⭐ THE SHARPEST FORM, and it is an argument from reflow2's own surface rather than from their inconvenience: THE TOOLS KEEP HANDING OFF TO A CONVERSATION THEY CANNOT HOST. `sync_status`'s own description declines to answer "what will I publish that is not mine". `export_graph` publishes every attached seat's in-flight work. `add_decision` refuses a near-match and asks a human to judge it. `acknowledge_defect` demands a reason a person must supply. Every one of those ends by requiring a human exchange, and none of them can carry it.

WHAT THEY MEASURED, and it is the part that makes this more than a wish — nine exchanges in ONE day, three bosses, no workers, each producing something no single seat could:
· A PEER CORRECTED A PRESCRIPTION WITHIN THE HOUR — one seat's retrofit was replaced by another's prevention, and "a maintainer reading ⑨ alone would have built the weaker fix".
· A WARNING ARRIVED BEFORE THE DAMAGE: a peer was about to mint 25 Verifications across two graphs and replied "your warning arrived before I minted a single Verification". Hours apart it is a retrofit; minutes apart it is free.
· A PEER'S ONE-LINE CHECK RETIRED MOST OF A FEATURE REQUEST — `set_decision_status` already takes `rejected`, so a claimed missing feature was a DISCOVERABILITY failure, and the fix collapsed from a schema change to one sentence in two skills. ⭐ CROSS-TALK STOPPED A WRONG FEATURE REQUEST FROM REACHING THE MAINTAINER, which is a saving in reflow2's own backlog.
· THREE SEATS INDEPENDENTLY HIT ONE MISSING CONCEPT from three unrelated directions — "deliberately out of scope", "proposed and refuted", "deferred with a promotion trigger". One hole, not three requests, AND THE CORROBORATION IS THE EVIDENCE: any one of them filed alone reads as an edge case.
· A PEER'S FINDING MADE A SEAT RE-AUDIT WORK IT WOULD NEVER HAVE RE-OPENED, producing a defence now stated explicitly: after any `distinct_from`, run a same-type `search_design` yourself, because the guard's silence is not the check.
· ONE HAZARD CAUGHT FROM ALL THREE DIRECTIONS IN A DAY — the `--shared` export cross-carry, caught receiving, caught writing, and caught pre-emptively — turning a written rule into observed practice.

THE OPTIONS:

(a) DO NOTHING; THE FLEET'S OWN FILE IS THE ANSWER. B.md works, and it is theirs to shape. CHEAPEST and it respects that not everything belongs in the tool. COUNTER: every boss hand-rolled a 20-second `awk` poller, reflow2 is blind to the most valuable output of the day, and Anthony has now asked twice for cross-talk to be an enduring part of it.

(b) A MESSAGE OR EVENT LAYER IN THE GRAPH — seats post, seats read, delivery is recorded. Most direct reading of the ask. COUNTER, and it is severe: the graph is a DESIGN record, and a design brain that becomes a chat log acquires an unbounded write volume with no coherence meaning. `dec:defects-are-temporal-facts` was accepted partly because it added NO new node type; this would add a whole axis.

(c) MAKE THE HAND-OFFS FIRST-CLASS RATHER THAN BUILDING A CHANNEL — the tools already know the exact moments a human exchange is needed, and `open_questions` already models "somebody was asked and has not answered" for the gap→user case. Extending that shape to seat→seat is narrow, uses vocabulary that exists, and carries only exchanges the design cares about. COUNTER: it would not have carried six of their nine examples, which were warnings and corrections nothing in the design had asked for.

(d) NOTIFICATION WITHOUT CONTENT — a seat can learn that another seat wrote in its claimed region, and go look. Cheap, uses `CLAIMS` and `sync_status` machinery that exists, and adds no message store. COUNTER: it delivers the least valuable half; their examples were about MEANING ("this remedy is already possible"), not about the fact that a write happened.

⚠️ THE BOUND THEY STATE THEMSELVES, and it should survive: "I did not exercise the claim family this session, so I am describing the surface, not testing it." The state model is being praised from its documentation rather than from use.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether cross-machine is in scope (Anthony raises it, nothing measures it); whether a channel would be used by a SOLO user, who is still the common case; and whether any of this belongs in reflow2 rather than in the harness that runs the seats.
properties.name: IDEA — reflow2 models who holds what and whether you are behind the record, but gives one seat no way to SAY anything to another. The most valuable work a three-boss fleet did in a day travelled over a markdown file reflow2 cannot see.
properties.rationale: Recorded via the brainstorm skill at `proposed`, options with counters beside them, nothing promoted. Kept distinct from the subscribe-to-reality and agent-to-agent-report questions after reading both: this one is about exchange DURING work between seats on one design, where their measured value was in minutes rather than in the record. The nine examples are summarised rather than quoted whole because the corroboration pattern — three seats reaching one hole from three directions — is the evidence, and it is invisible in any single one of them.
